name: tracklution-mcp
description: Discovery wedge for the Tracklution MCP server at https://mcp.tracklution.com/mcp. Today this is an alias of the `tracklution` package and prints the agent install protocol. Future versions will offer a local stdio<->Streamable-HTTP MCP proxy for clients without remote MCP support. Protocol: https://www.tracklution.com/agent-install.md
